march/motion#scrollTimeline.name: scrollTimeline
march/motion#scrollTimeline.doc: Bind a Playback to scroll: its progress follows the scroll position (a paused animation seeked each frame). Pass keyframes (target + frames) or a ready Playback / timeline. Returns a stop function.
march/motion#scrollTimeline.signature: function scrollTimeline(target: unknown, frames?: KeyframesInput | null, o: ScrollTimelineOptions = {}): () => void
march/motion#scrollTimeline.tr: Bir Playback'i kaydırmaya bağlar: ilerlemesi kaydırma konumunu izler (her karede konumlanan duraklatılmış animasyon). Anahtar kareler (hedef + kareler) ya da hazır bir Playback / zaman çizelgesi verilir. Durdurma işlevi döndürür.

march/motion#setReducedMotion.name: setReducedMotion
march/motion#setReducedMotion.doc: Force reduced motion on/off (tests, user setting); null follows the system again.
march/motion#setReducedMotion.tr: Azaltılmış hareketi zorla açar/kapatır (testler, kullanıcı ayarı); null sistemi yeniden izler.

march/motion#shapeMorph.name: shapeMorph
march/motion#shapeMorph.doc: Morph an element's outline to a shape (clip-path polygon). The current outline is read from the element.
march/motion#shapeMorph.signature: function shapeMorph(el: Element, to: ShapeName, o: AnimateOptions & { points?: number } = {}): Playback
march/motion#shapeMorph.tr: Bir öğenin ana hattını bir şekle (clip-path çokgeni) dönüştürür. Geçerli ana hat öğeden okunur.

march/motion#shapePolygon.name: shapePolygon
march/motion#shapePolygon.doc: A clip-path polygon for a shape (n points; the same n for every shape, so they morph).
march/motion#shapePolygon.signature: function shapePolygon(shape: ShapeName, n: number = 60): string
march/motion#shapePolygon.tr: Bir şekil için clip-path çokgeni (n nokta; her şekil için aynı n, böylece dönüşebilirler).

march/motion#sharedTransition.name: sharedTransition
march/motion#sharedTransition.doc: Run `update` (which renders the next view) so that `from` morphs into the element marked `data-m-shared={name}` in the new view. Resolves when the transition has finished.
march/motion#sharedTransition.signature: function sharedTransition(name: string, from: Element | null, update: () => void | Promise<void>, o: { duration?: number } = {}): Promise<void>
march/motion#sharedTransition.tr: Sonraki görünümü çizen `update`'i çalıştırır; `from`, yeni görünümde `data-m-shared={name}` ile işaretli öğeye dönüşür. Geçiş bitince çözülür.

march/motion#spotlight.name: spotlight
march/motion#spotlight.doc: Light the cards under `root` from the pointer. Returns a function that stops it and puts the lights out.
march/motion#spotlight.signature: function spotlight(root: Document | Element, o: SpotlightOptions): () => void
march/motion#spotlight.tr: `root` altındaki kartları imleçten aydınlatır: imlece yakın bütün kartlar gerçek imleç konumundan ışık alır (iki kart arasındaki boşlukta da). Durduran ve ışıkları söndüren işlevi döndürür.

march/motion#spring.name: spring
march/motion#spring.doc: Physics spring toward `source()` (velocity carries across target changes — feels natural for drags).
march/motion#spring.signature: function spring<T extends Animatable>(source: () => T, opts: SpringOptions = {}): Animated<T>
march/motion#spring.tr: `source()` değerine doğru fizik yayı (hız hedef değişikliklerinde korunur — sürüklemelerde doğal hissettirir).

march/motion#springEase.name: springEase
march/motion#springEase.doc: A damped spring as an easing: exact physics, a natural duration, and a CSS linear() curve for WAAPI.
march/motion#springEase.tr: Yumuşatma olarak sönümlü yay: tam fizik, doğal süre ve WAAPI için CSS linear() eğrisi.

march/motion#stack.name: stack
march/motion#stack.doc: Cards stack: the new page slides over the old one, which sinks back (back: it slides off again).
march/motion#stack.tr: Kartlar yığılır: yeni sayfa eskinin üstüne kayar, eski geriye çöker (geri: yeniden dışarı kayar).

march/motion#stagger.name: stagger
march/motion#stagger.doc: Stagger helper: delay for item i (ms). `from`: "start" | "end" | "center" | "edges" | index.
march/motion#stagger.signature: function stagger(each: number = 40, o: Parameters<typeof engineStagger>[1] = {}): (i: number, total?: number) => number
march/motion#stagger.tr: Kademeli gecikme yardımcısı: i. öğe için gecikme (ms). `from`: "start" | "end" | "center" | "edges" | dizin.

march/motion#staggerIn.name: staggerIn
march/motion#staggerIn.doc: Bring a set of elements in one after another (preset keyframes, engine stagger: linear, from the centre or in a grid).
march/motion#staggerIn.signature: function staggerIn(targets: ArrayLike<Element> | string, o: StaggerInOptions = {}): Playback
march/motion#staggerIn.tr: Bir öğe kümesini sırayla getirir (hazır anahtar kareler, motor kademesi: doğrusal, merkezden ya da ızgarada).

march/motion#stateMorph.name: stateMorph
march/motion#stateMorph.doc: Morph a button between states: loading narrows it to a circle with a spinner, success and error draw a check or a cross over the success / danger colour (error also shakes), idle restores it. The colours come from the theme tokens through `data-m-state` (motion.css). Returns the main Playback.
march/motion#stateMorph.signature: function stateMorph(el: Element, state: ButtonState, o: StateMorphOptions = {}): Playback
march/motion#stateMorph.tr: Bir düğmeyi durumlar arasında dönüştürür: loading onu döndürücülü daireye daraltır, success ve error başarı / tehlike renginin üzerine onay veya çarpı çizer (error ayrıca sallar), idle geri yükler. Renkler temadan gelir.

march/motion#stickyReveal.name: stickyReveal
march/motion#stickyReveal.doc: A tall section with a sticky stage: as the section scrolls by, the steps come in one after another (each fades and rises in, then out). The section sets `--m-scroll` (0..1) on itself for CSS extras. Returns a stop function.
march/motion#stickyReveal.signature: function stickyReveal(section: HTMLElement, o: StickyRevealOptions = {}): () => void
march/motion#stickyReveal.tr: Yapışkan sahneli uzun bölüm: bölüm kaydıkça adımlar sırayla gelir (her biri belirip yükselir, sonra çıkar). Bölüm kendi üzerine `--m-scroll` (0..1) yazar. Durdurma işlevi döndürür.

march/motion#supportsLinear.name: supportsLinear
march/motion#supportsLinear.doc: True when the browser runs CSS linear() easings (springs and bounces then stay native).
march/motion#supportsLinear.tr: Tarayıcı CSS linear() yumuşatmalarını çalıştırıyorsa true (yaylar ve sekmeler o zaman yerel kalır).

march/motion#swipe.name: swipe
march/motion#swipe.doc: Action: detect a swipe (left/right/up/down) with distance and velocity thresholds.
march/motion#swipe.signature: function swipe(el: Element, raw?: unknown): () => void
march/motion#swipe.tr: Eylem: mesafe ve hız eşikleriyle kaydırma hareketini (sol/sağ/yukarı/aşağı) algılar.

march/motion#themeWave.name: themeWave
march/motion#themeWave.doc: Run a restyle as a wave of the new look. Resolves when the wave is over.
march/motion#themeWave.signature: function themeWave(change: () => void, o: ThemeWaveOptions = {}, taken?: unknown): Promise<void>
march/motion#themeWave.tr: Bir yeniden boyamayı, `origin` noktasından büyüyen yeni görünüm dairesi olarak çalıştırır (Görünüm Geçişi yoksa, azaltılmış harekette ya da duraklatılmışken anında). Dalga bitince çözülür.

march/motion#tilt.name: tilt
march/motion#tilt.doc: Action: 3D tilt toward the pointer (max degrees), with an optional glare via --m-tilt-x/--m-tilt-y custom properties.
march/motion#tilt.signature: function tilt(el: Element, raw?: unknown): () => void
march/motion#tilt.tr: Eylem: işaretçiye doğru 3B eğim (en çok derece), --m-tilt-x/--m-tilt-y özel özellikleriyle isteğe bağlı parlama.

march/motion#timeline.name: timeline
march/motion#timeline.doc: A timeline: add steps (`at`, labels, stagger), then control them as one. Paused until play().
march/motion#timeline.signature: function timeline(opts: AnimateOptions & { defaults?: AnimateOptions } = {}): Playback
march/motion#timeline.tr: Zaman çizelgesi: adımlar ekleyin (`at`, etiketler, stagger), sonra tek parça olarak denetleyin. play() çağrılana dek duraklatılmış.

march/motion#toD.name: toD
march/motion#toD.signature: function toD(pts: ArrayLike<number>, closed: boolean): string

march/motion#toLinear.name: toLinear
march/motion#toLinear.doc: Sample `fn` into a CSS linear() easing (points that a straight line already covers are dropped).
march/motion#toLinear.signature: function toLinear(fn: (t: number) => number, points: number = 48): string
march/motion#toLinear.tr: `fn` işlevini CSS linear() yumuşatmasına örnekler (düz bir çizginin zaten kapsadığı noktalar atılır).

march/motion#track.name: track
march/motion#track.doc: A signal that follows `source()` smoothly. Cleans up with the current owner.
march/motion#track.signature: function track<T extends number | number[]>(source: () => T, opts: TrackOptions = {}): Tracked<T>
march/motion#track.tr: `source()` değerini yumuşakça izleyen bir sinyal. Geçerli sahiple birlikte temizlenir.

march/motion#Track.name: Track
march/motion#Track.doc: A compiled property track. Drivers read `out` (numbers) or `text()` (CSS string).

ctor.text: new Track(raw: RawTrack, current: () => Value): Track

members.name: prop
members.summary: The name of the animated property.

members.name: out
members.summary: The current sampled value (written by sample()).

members.name: scalar
members.summary: The value was a plain number (not a string or a vector).

members.name: vector
members.summary: The value was an array / typed array (a vector).

members.name: sample
members.summary: Sample at progress p (0..1, may overshoot with back / spring easings: the end segments extrapolate).

members.name: text
members.summary: The current value as a CSS string (colors as oklab()).

members.name: num
members.summary: The first number of the current value.

members.name: rgba
members.signature: rgba(dest: Float32Array | Float64Array | number[], j: number = 0): void
members.summary: Colors only: sRGB 0..1 + alpha into `dest` (WebGL uniforms).

march/motion#Track.tr: Derlenmiş özellik izi. Sürücüler `out` (sayılar) veya `text()` (CSS dizesi) okur.

march/motion#transitionFrames.name: transitionFrames
march/motion#transitionFrames.doc: The keyframes of one side of a page transition (back reverses it; RTL mirrors "slide").
march/motion#transitionFrames.signature: function transitionFrames(type: PageTransitionType, side: "in" | "out", dir: Dir, rtl: boolean = false, distance: number = 32): Keyframe[]
march/motion#transitionFrames.tr: Sayfa geçişinin bir tarafının anahtar kareleri (geri onu tersine çevirir; RTL "slide" geçişini yansıtır).

march/motion#tween.name: tween
march/motion#tween.doc: Smoothly animate toward `source()` whenever it changes (duration-based).
march/motion#tween.signature: function tween<T extends Animatable>(source: () => T, opts: TweenOptions = {}): Animated<T>
march/motion#tween.tr: `source()` her değiştiğinde ona doğru yumuşakça canlanır (süre tabanlı).

march/motion#usePageTransitions.name: usePageTransitions
march/motion#usePageTransitions.doc: Register variants so routes can name them in `meta.transition`.
march/motion#usePageTransitions.tr: Rotaların `meta.transition` içinde adlandırabilmesi için varyantları kaydeder.

march/motion#viewTransition.name: viewTransition
march/motion#viewTransition.doc: Run a DOM update as a View Transition where supported (the browser animates old → new snapshots on the compositor); without support, with reduced motion or while paused, the update simply runs.
march/motion#viewTransition.tr: Desteklenen yerde bir DOM güncellemesini Görünüm Geçişi olarak çalıştırır (tarayıcı eski → yeni anlık görüntüleri bileşimleyicide canlandırır); destek yoksa, azaltılmış harekette veya duraklatılmışken güncelleme doğrudan çalışır.

march/motion#webgl.name: webgl
march/motion#webgl.doc: A WebGL program as an animation target: every field of `state` is a uniform (number → float, [x, y] → vec2, colors → vec4 in sRGB 0..1). `uniforms` maps a field to another uniform name. `draw(gl)` issues the draw call.
march/motion#webgl.signature: function webgl<S extends object>(gl: GL, program: WebGLProgram, o: { state: S; draw: (gl: GL, state: S) => void; uniforms?: Record<string, string> }): WebGLTarget<S>

params.name: o
params.type: { state: S; draw: (gl: GL, state: S) => void; uniforms?: Record<string, string> }

march/motion#webgl.tr: Animasyon hedefi olarak WebGL programı: `state` içindeki her alan bir uniform'dur (sayı → float, [x, y] → vec2, renkler → sRGB 0..1 vec4). `uniforms` bir alanı başka bir uniform adına eşler. `draw(gl)` çizim çağrısını yapar.

march/motion#wipe.name: wipe
march/motion#wipe.doc: A straight wipe from the inline end (forward) or start (back); mirrored in RTL.
march/motion#wipe.tr: Satır içi sondan (ileri) veya başlangıçtan (geri) düz silme; RTL'de yansıtılır.

march/motion#yieldToMain.name: yieldToMain
march/motion#yieldToMain.doc: Give the main thread back (scheduler.yield where available): long setup work stays under the 50 ms long-task line.
march/motion#yieldToMain.tr: Ana iş parçacığını geri verir (varsa scheduler.yield): uzun kurulum işleri 50 ms uzun görev sınırının altında kalır.

march/motion#zoomThrough.name: zoomThrough
march/motion#zoomThrough.doc: Fly through: the old page grows past the viewer, the new one comes up from the distance (back: the reverse).
march/motion#zoomThrough.tr: İçinden uçuş: eski sayfa izleyicinin yanından büyüyerek geçer, yenisi uzaktan yaklaşır (geri: tersi).

march/motion/text#blurIn.name: blurIn
march/motion/text#blurIn.signature: function blurIn(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation

march/motion/text#bounce.name: bounce
march/motion/text#bounce.signature: function bounce(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation

march/motion/text#bounceIn.name: bounceIn
march/motion/text#bounceIn.doc: Characters fall and bounce on the baseline.
march/motion/text#bounceIn.signature: function bounceIn(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#bounceIn.tr: Karakterler düşer ve taban çizgisinde zıplar.

march/motion/text#breathe.name: breathe
march/motion/text#breathe.doc: Letter spacing breathes in and out (letter-spacing).
march/motion/text#breathe.signature: function breathe(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#breathe.tr: Harf aralığı nefes alır gibi açılıp kapanır (letter-spacing).

march/motion/text#cascade.name: cascade
march/motion/text#cascade.doc: Characters tumble down from above, turning.
march/motion/text#cascade.signature: function cascade(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation

march/motion/text#counter.name: counter
march/motion/text#counter.doc: Counts up to the number in the text, formatted for the locale.
march/motion/text#counter.signature: function counter(el: El, o: CounterOptions = {}): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#counter.tr: Metindeki sayıya kadar sayar, dile göre biçimlendirir.

march/motion/text#decode.name: decode
march/motion/text#decode.doc: Characters appear as flickering binary in random order, then decode.
march/motion/text#decode.signature: function decode(el: El, o: ScrambleOptions = {}): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#decode.tr: Karakterler rastgele sırayla titreşen ikili kod olarak belirir, sonra çözülür.

march/motion/text#dissolve.name: dissolve
march/motion/text#dissolve.doc: Characters appear in random order, like a slow dissolve.
march/motion/text#dissolve.signature: function dissolve(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#dissolve.tr: Karakterler yavaş bir çözülme gibi rastgele sırayla belirir.

march/motion/text#drop.name: drop
march/motion/text#drop.signature: function drop(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation

march/motion/text#elastic.name: elastic
march/motion/text#elastic.doc: Characters stretch in on an elastic spring.
march/motion/text#elastic.signature: function elastic(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation

march/motion/text#explode.name: explode
march/motion/text#explode.doc: Characters burst apart and vanish (an exit; `out: true` assembles them instead).
march/motion/text#explode.signature: function explode(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#explode.tr: Karakterler dağılıp kaybolur (bir çıkış; `out: true` bunun yerine onları bir araya getirir).

march/motion/text#fade.name: fade
march/motion/text#fade.signature: function fade(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation

march/motion/text#flip.name: flip
march/motion/text#flip.signature: function flip(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation

march/motion/text#float.name: float
march/motion/text#float.doc: Words drift gently, as if under water.
march/motion/text#float.signature: function float(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#float.tr: Kelimeler suyun altındaymış gibi yumuşakça süzülür.

march/motion/text#glitch.name: glitch
march/motion/text#glitch.doc: A digital glitch: characters jump and split into color channels.
march/motion/text#glitch.signature: function glitch(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#glitch.tr: Dijital arıza: karakterler zıplar ve renk kanallarına ayrılır.

march/motion/text#glow.name: glow
march/motion/text#glow.doc: A soft glow pulses behind the text (text-shadow).
march/motion/text#glow.signature: function glow(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#glow.tr: Metnin arkasında yumuşak bir parıltı atar (text-shadow).

march/motion/text#gradientSweep.name: gradientSweep
march/motion/text#gradientSweep.doc: A band of color sweeps once across the text (gradient text), leaving it as it was.
march/motion/text#gradientSweep.signature: function gradientSweep(el: El, o: MarkOptions = {}): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#gradientSweep.tr: Metin üzerinden bir kez renk bandı geçer (gradyan metin) ve metni eski haline bırakır.

march/motion/text#graphemes.name: graphemes
march/motion/text#graphemes.doc: Grapheme clusters of a string (Intl.Segmenter; code points where it is missing).
march/motion/text#graphemes.tr: Bir dizenin grafem kümeleri (Intl.Segmenter; yoksa kod noktaları).

march/motion/text#highlight.name: highlight
march/motion/text#highlight.doc: A marker pen highlights each line.
march/motion/text#highlight.signature: function highlight(el: El, o: MarkOptions = {}): TextAnimation

march/motion/text#implode.name: implode
march/motion/text#implode.doc: Characters fly in from scattered positions and assemble.
march/motion/text#implode.signature: function implode(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#implode.tr: Karakterler dağınık konumlardan uçarak gelip bir araya gelir.

march/motion/text#inkBleed.name: inkBleed
march/motion/text#inkBleed.doc: Words spread like ink on paper, from the middle out (filter).
march/motion/text#inkBleed.signature: function inkBleed(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#inkBleed.tr: Kelimeler kağıttaki mürekkep gibi ortadan dışa yayılır (filter).

march/motion/text#isRtl.name: isRtl
march/motion/text#isRtl.doc: True when the element's text runs right to left (computed `direction`, else the nearest `dir` attribute).
march/motion/text#isRtl.signature: function isRtl(el: Element | null | undefined): boolean
march/motion/text#isRtl.tr: Öğenin metni sağdan sola akıyorsa true döner (hesaplanmış `direction`, yoksa en yakın `dir` özniteliği).

march/motion/text#jelly.name: jelly
march/motion/text#jelly.signature: function jelly(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation

march/motion/text#jitter.name: jitter
march/motion/text#jitter.signature: function jitter(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation

march/motion/text#magnetic.name: magnetic
march/motion/text#magnetic.signature: const magnetic: (el: HTMLElement, o?: PointerOptions) => TextAnimation

march/motion/text#maskReveal.name: maskReveal
march/motion/text#maskReveal.doc: Words rise out of a mask (clip-path).
march/motion/text#maskReveal.signature: function maskReveal(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation

march/motion/text#matrix.name: matrix
march/motion/text#matrix.doc: Green glyphs rain into place and turn into the text.
march/motion/text#matrix.signature: function matrix(el: El, o: ScrambleOptions = {}): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#matrix.tr: Yeşil karakterler yağmur gibi yerine düşer ve metne dönüşür.

march/motion/text#morph.name: morph
march/motion/text#morph.doc: Texts melt into each other with a blur.
march/motion/text#morph.signature: function morph(el: El, o: CycleOptions = {}): TextAnimation

march/motion/text#neon.name: neon
march/motion/text#neon.signature: function neon(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation

march/motion/text#odometer.name: odometer
march/motion/text#odometer.doc: Each digit rolls like a mechanical counter wheel.
march/motion/text#odometer.signature: function odometer(el: El, o: TextOptions = {}): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#odometer.tr: Her rakam mekanik sayaç çarkı gibi döner.

march/motion/text#order.name: order
march/motion/text#order.signature: function order(n: number, from: StaggerFrom = "start"): number[]
march/motion/text#order.tr: n parça için kademeli sıra değerleri üretir.

march/motion/text#parseNumber.name: parseNumber
march/motion/text#parseNumber.signature: function parseNumber(t: string): { value: number; decimals: number; before: string; after: string } | null

returns.type: { value: number; decimals: number; before: string; after: string } | null

march/motion/text#perspective.name: perspective
march/motion/text#perspective.doc: Words come forward out of the depth (3D).
march/motion/text#perspective.signature: function perspective(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation

march/motion/text#pixelate.name: pixelate
march/motion/text#pixelate.doc: Characters resolve in coarse steps, like a low-resolution image sharpening (filter).
march/motion/text#pixelate.signature: function pixelate(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#pixelate.tr: Karakterler, düşük çözünürlüklü bir görüntünün netleşmesi gibi kaba adımlarla belirginleşir (filter).

march/motion/text#pop.name: pop
march/motion/text#pop.doc: Characters pop up with a small overshoot.
march/motion/text#pop.signature: function pop(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#pop.tr: Karakterler küçük bir aşımla zıplayarak belirir.

march/motion/text#pulse.name: pulse
march/motion/text#pulse.doc: Characters swell and shrink in turn.
march/motion/text#pulse.signature: function pulse(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation

march/motion/text#rainbow.name: rainbow
march/motion/text#rainbow.signature: function rainbow(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation

march/motion/text#repel.name: repel
march/motion/text#repel.doc: Characters dodge away from the pointer.
march/motion/text#repel.signature: const repel: (el: HTMLElement, o?: PointerOptions) => TextAnimation

march/motion/text#rise.name: rise
march/motion/text#rise.signature: function rise(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation

march/motion/text#rotateIn.name: rotateIn
march/motion/text#rotateIn.doc: Characters spin in from a half turn.
march/motion/text#rotateIn.signature: function rotateIn(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation

march/motion/text#scramble.name: scramble
march/motion/text#scramble.doc: Characters spin through random glyphs and settle one by one.
march/motion/text#scramble.signature: function scramble(el: El, o: ScrambleOptions = {}): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#scramble.tr: Karakterler rastgele glifler arasında döner ve tek tek yerine oturur.

march/motion/text#shake.name: shake
march/motion/text#shake.signature: function shake(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation

march/motion/text#shimmer.name: shimmer
march/motion/text#shimmer.doc: A light band sweeps across the text, over and over (gradient text).
march/motion/text#shimmer.signature: function shimmer(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#shimmer.tr: Metin üzerinden bir ışık bandı tekrar tekrar geçer (gradyan metin).

march/motion/text#skewIn.name: skewIn
march/motion/text#skewIn.signature: function skewIn(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#skewIn.tr: Karakterler öne eğik halde kayarak girer.

march/motion/text#slideIn.name: slideIn
march/motion/text#slideIn.doc: Characters slide in along the reading direction (mirrored for RTL).
march/motion/text#slideIn.signature: function slideIn(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#slideIn.tr: Karakterler okuma yönünde kayarak girer (RTL için yansıtılır).

march/motion/text#spin.name: spin
march/motion/text#spin.doc: Characters turn a full circle around their vertical axis.
march/motion/text#spin.signature: function spin(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#spin.tr: Karakterler dikey eksenleri etrafında tam tur döner.

march/motion/text#splitFlap.name: splitFlap
march/motion/text#splitFlap.doc: A split-flap board: each character flips through the alphabet to its letter.
march/motion/text#splitFlap.signature: function splitFlap(el: El, o: ScrambleOptions = {}): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#splitFlap.tr: Çevrilir tabela: her karakter alfabede dönerek kendi harfine ulaşır.

march/motion/text#splitReveal.name: splitReveal
march/motion/text#splitReveal.doc: Alternate characters come from above and below.
march/motion/text#splitReveal.signature: function splitReveal(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#splitReveal.tr: Karakterler dönüşümlü olarak yukarıdan ve aşağıdan gelir.

march/motion/text#splitText.name: splitText
march/motion/text#splitText.doc: Split `el` into characters, words or lines (see the module comment). Splitting again reverts the earlier split.
march/motion/text#splitText.signature: function splitText(el: HTMLElement, by: SplitBy = "char"): SplitText
march/motion/text#splitText.tr: `el` öğesini karakterlere, kelimelere veya satırlara böler (modül yorumuna bakın). Yeniden bölmek önceki bölmeyi geri alır.

march/motion/text#strike.name: strike
march/motion/text#strike.doc: A line strikes through the text.
march/motion/text#strike.signature: function strike(el: El, o: MarkOptions = {}): TextAnimation

march/motion/text#strokeDraw.name: strokeDraw
march/motion/text#strokeDraw.doc: The letter outlines are drawn with a pen (SVG stroke), then filled.
march/motion/text#strokeDraw.signature: function strokeDraw(el: El, o: MarkOptions = {}): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#strokeDraw.tr: Harf dış çizgileri kalemle çizilir (SVG stroke), ardından doldurulur.

march/motion/text#swing.name: swing
march/motion/text#swing.doc: Characters swing down from their top edge like signs on a hook.
march/motion/text#swing.signature: function swing(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#swing.tr: Karakterler kancadaki tabelalar gibi üst kenarlarından aşağı sallanır.

march/motion/text#tilt.name: tilt
march/motion/text#tilt.doc: Words tilt in from the side (3D).
march/motion/text#tilt.signature: function tilt(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation

march/motion/text#trackIn.name: trackIn
march/motion/text#trackIn.doc: Lines contract from wide letter spacing into focus (letter-spacing, filter).
march/motion/text#trackIn.signature: function trackIn(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#trackIn.tr: Satırlar geniş harf aralığından odağa daralır (letter-spacing, filter).

march/motion/text#typeLoop.name: typeLoop
march/motion/text#typeLoop.doc: Types a word, deletes it, types the next one: forever.
march/motion/text#typeLoop.signature: function typeLoop(el: El, o: CycleOptions = {}): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#typeLoop.tr: Bir kelimeyi yazar, siler, sonrakini yazar: sonsuza kadar.

march/motion/text#typewriter.name: typewriter
march/motion/text#typewriter.doc: Types the text one character at a time, with a caret. `out: true` deletes it.
march/motion/text#typewriter.signature: function typewriter(el: El, o: TypeOptions = {}): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#typewriter.tr: Metni imleçle birlikte karakter karakter yazar. `out: true` metni siler.

march/motion/text#underline.name: underline
march/motion/text#underline.doc: An underline draws itself under each line.
march/motion/text#underline.signature: function underline(el: El, o: MarkOptions = {}): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#underline.tr: Her satırın altına bir alt çizgi kendiliğinden çizilir.

march/motion/text#wave.name: wave
march/motion/text#wave.doc: Characters ripple up and down in a wave.
march/motion/text#wave.signature: function wave(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#wave.tr: Karakterler dalga gibi aşağı yukarı dalgalanır.

march/motion/text#wipe.name: wipe
march/motion/text#wipe.doc: Lines are wiped on along the reading direction (clip-path).
march/motion/text#wipe.signature: function wipe(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#wipe.tr: Satırlar okuma yönünde silinerek ortaya çıkar (clip-path).

march/motion/text#wordCycle.name: wordCycle
march/motion/text#wordCycle.doc: Words roll in from below and out at the top, one after another.
march/motion/text#wordCycle.signature: function wordCycle(el: El, o: CycleOptions = {}): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#wordCycle.tr: Kelimeler sırayla aşağıdan girip yukarıdan çıkar.

march/motion/text#zoomIn.name: zoomIn
march/motion/text#zoomIn.doc: Characters shrink into place from large.
march/motion/text#zoomIn.signature: function zoomIn(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation
march/motion/text#zoomIn.tr: Karakterler büyük boyuttan küçülerek yerine oturur.

march/motion/text/meta#TEXT_ANIMATIONS.name: TEXT_ANIMATIONS
march/motion/text/meta#TEXT_ANIMATIONS.doc: Every text animation with its family (enter, exit, loop, decorate, change, interactive), split mode and cost.
march/motion/text/meta#TEXT_ANIMATIONS.value:
[
  ...fam("enter", ALL, "fade dissolve blurIn rise drop slideIn pop zoomIn flip rotateIn swing elastic bounceIn tilt perspective skewIn splitReveal maskReveal wipe cascade spin jelly trackIn implode explode inkBleed pixelate glitch shake"),
  ...fam("loop", ALL, "wave bounce jitter float pulse rainbow neon breathe glow shimmer"),
  ...fam("decorate", LINE, "highlight underline strike gradientSweep strokeDraw"),
  ...fam("content", TIME, "typewriter scramble decode matrix splitFlap=KALKIŞ_09:45 counter=₺12.500 odometer=2026"),
  ...fam("content", NONE, "typeLoop=hızlı|küçük|erişilebilir wordCycle=hızlı|küçük|erişilebilir morph=Merhaba|Hello|مرحبا"),
  ...fam("interactive", NONE, "magnetic repel"),
]
march/motion/text/meta#TEXT_ANIMATIONS.tr: Tüm metin animasyonları; aile (enter, exit, loop, decorate, change, interactive), bölme kipi ve maliyetiyle.

march/fx#Aurora.name: Aurora
march/fx#Aurora.doc: Animated, blurred color blobs behind content. `<Aurora colors={["#6d5dfc", "#22d3ee", "#a3e635"]} />`
march/fx#Aurora.tr: İçeriğin arkasında animasyonlu, bulanık renk lekeleri. `<Aurora colors={["#6d5dfc", "#22d3ee", "#a3e635"]} />`

march/fx#confetti.name: confetti
march/fx#confetti.doc: Confetti burst from a point (defaults to the screen center). Removes its canvas when done.
march/fx#confetti.signature: function confetti(__0: { x?: number; y?: number; count?: number; colors?: string[]; spread?: number } = {}): Promise<void>

params.type: { x?: number; y?: number; count?: number; colors?: string[]; spread?: number }

march/fx#confetti.tr: Bir noktadan (varsayılan ekran merkezi) konfeti patlaması. Bitince tuvalini kaldırır.

march/fx#Particles.name: Particles
march/fx#Particles.doc: Floating particles with optional connecting lines and pointer attraction. `<Particles count={80} links={120} speed={0.3} color="var(--m-primary)" interactive class="m-fx-fill" />`
march/fx#Particles.tr: İsteğe bağlı bağlantı çizgileri ve imleç çekimi olan yüzen parçacıklar. `<Particles count={80} links={120} speed={0.3} color="var(--m-primary)" interactive class="m-fx-fill" />`

march/fx#spotlight.name: spotlight
march/fx#spotlight.doc: Pointer-following radial light on an element (sets --m-spot-x/--m-spot-y). `use:spotlight`
march/fx#spotlight.tr: Bir öğe üzerinde imleci izleyen radyal ışık (--m-spot-x/--m-spot-y ayarlar). `use:spotlight`

march/store#derive.name: derive
march/store#derive.doc: A derived value (computed): `const total = derive(() => app.cart.items.reduce(…))`.

march/store#history.name: history
march/store#history.doc: Undo/redo for a store node (snapshot per change group).
march/store#history.signature: function history<T extends object>(node: T, __1: { limit?: number } = {}): History
march/store#history.tr: Bir depo düğümü için geri al/yinele (değişiklik grubu başına anlık görüntü).

march/store#on.name: on
march/store#on.doc: Listen to a path (relative to `node`): "cart.items", "users.*.name", "logs.**". Type-checked against the store.
march/store#on.signature: function on<T extends object, P extends Path<T>>(node: T, path: P, fn: (event: StoreEvent & { value?: PathValue<T, P> }) => void): () => void
march/store#on.tr: Bir yolu dinler (`node`a göreli): "cart.items", "users.*.name", "logs.**". Depoya göre tür denetimlidir.

march/store#persist.name: persist
march/store#persist.doc: Save a store node to localStorage (debounced) and load it back now. Errors (private mode, quota) are ignored.
march/store#persist.signature: function persist<T extends object>(node: T, key: string, __2: { storage?: Storage; delay?: number } = {}): () => void
march/store#persist.tr: Bir depo düğümünü localStorage'a kaydeder (geciktirmeli) ve hemen geri yükler. Hatalar (gizli mod, kota) yok sayılır.

march/store#readonly.name: readonly
march/store#readonly.doc: Read-only view: reads stay reactive; writes throw.
march/store#readonly.signature: function readonly<T extends object>(node: T): Readonly<T>
march/store#readonly.tr: Salt okunur görünüm: okumalar tepkisel kalır; yazmalar hata fırlatır.

march/store#snapshot.name: snapshot
march/store#snapshot.doc: Deeply frozen plain copy of a store node (safe to keep, compare or serialize).
march/store#snapshot.tr: Bir depo düğümünün derinlemesine dondurulmuş düz kopyası (saklamak, karşılaştırmak veya serileştirmek için güvenli).

march/store#storeLog.name: storeLog
march/store#storeLog.doc: Development change log of a store (last 1000 changes; empty in production).
march/store#storeLog.tr: Deponun geliştirme değişiklik günlüğü (son 1000 değişiklik; üretimde boş).

march/store#subscribe.name: subscribe
march/store#subscribe.doc: Listen to every change at or below `node` (a store or any nested object/array of it). Returns unsubscribe.
march/store#subscribe.signature: function subscribe(node: object, fn: Listener): () => void
march/store#subscribe.tr: `node` ve altındaki (depo veya içindeki herhangi bir iç içe nesne/dizi) her değişikliği dinler. Abonelikten çıkma işlevini döndürür.

march/db#compareKeys.name: compareKeys
march/db#compareKeys.doc: IndexedDB's order of keys: numbers < dates < strings < binary < arrays (each array item by item).
march/db#compareKeys.signature: function compareKeys(a: unknown, b: unknown): number
march/db#compareKeys.tr: İki anahtarı IndexedDB'nin sırasıyla karşılaştırır (sayı < tarih < metin < ikili < dizi).

march/db#inRange.name: inRange
march/db#inRange.doc: A key is in the query's range.
march/db#inRange.signature: function inRange(k: unknown, q: DbQuery<never>): boolean
march/db#inRange.tr: Bir anahtar sorgunun aralığında mı (eq, gt, gte, lt, lte, prefix).

march/db#keyAt.name: keyAt
march/db#keyAt.doc: The value at a key path ("a.b") of a record; an array path gives an array key.
march/db#keyAt.signature: function keyAt(value: unknown, path: string | string[]): unknown
march/db#keyAt.tr: Bir kaydın anahtar yolundaki değeri ("a.b"; dizi yol dizi anahtar verir).

march/db#openDb.name: openDb
march/db#openDb.doc: Opens (or makes) a database with its stores; it is usable at once (calls wait for it to open).
march/db#openDb.signature: function openDb(name: string, opts: DbOptions): Db
march/db#openDb.tr: IndexedDB veritabanı açar: depolar, dizinler, sorgular, işlemler, canlı sorgular; IndexedDB yoksa bellekte çalışır.

march/vault#_resetVaults.name: _resetVaults
march/vault#_resetVaults.doc: Tests: forget the vaults made so far (the next createVault makes a new one).

march/vault#createVault.name: createVault
march/vault#createVault.doc: The vault of this name (one per name and page: calls with the same name get the same vault).
march/vault#createVault.tr: Kullanıcının parolasıyla şifreli kasa: anahtarlar yalnız bellekte, diskte (IndexedDB) yalnız şifreli veri.

march/vault#passLength.name: passLength
march/vault#passLength.doc: A passphrase's length as the vault counts it (characters, after NFC normalization).
march/vault#passLength.tr: Kasanın saydığı biçimde parola uzunluğu (NFC sonrası karakter).

march/vault#unlockDelay.name: unlockDelay
march/vault#unlockDelay.doc: How long the next try waits after `fails` wrong ones: none for three, then 2^(n-3) s, at most 5 minutes.
march/vault#unlockDelay.tr: Yanlış denemelerden sonra bir sonraki denemeye kadar beklenecek süre (ms).
